note: The strokes of tests/gpu_matrix.py: each names its tool by its button's data-tool (paint, erase, light), which stays when a label or a key changes; x and y from 0 to 1 on the frame, as ui_live.py's --strokes and --fluid. A colour is one of the page's swatches. A case's « seed » is the page's ?seed=: its first edit and its fluid shot start from it, each next edit from the next number, so a case paints the same strokes from the same seeds at every run. horse_erase's seed is a hard one for an erase with no words: at it, Klein's prompt writer can name the horse instead of the barn. A case with « like » takes another case's strokes and its seed, its brush multiplied by « scale ». The places on horse.mp4 were set on its first frame: the camera pans right, so what stands behind the fence slides left and passes behind the horse. horse_erase_barn is horse_erase with its object named, « the barn »; it is outside quick and all. horse_saddle (a blanket painted on the horse's back) and horse_bird (a crow on the right fence post that sits still, then flies away) are recordings of the follow matte (PAINTAPLATE_RECORD), outside quick and all too. hdr_cow paints horse_cow's strokes from its seed on the HDR test plate (tests/hdr_plate.py makes it from horse.mp4 when it is missing), with SDR to HDR on, so the report gives HDR Match's line; it is outside quick and all. tos_arm paints a robotic arm over the raised forearm of shot 05_4a of Tears of Steel (CC BY 3.0) and over everything strapped on it, in one wide stroke whose words say what each strapped part becomes: its 121 EXR frames, 480 to 600 of https://media.xiph.org/tearsofsteel/tearsofsteel-footage-exr/05_4a/linear_hd/, in input/plates/tos_05_4a, with SDR to HDR on. Its stage_frames draw stages.png, and it is outside quick and all. car_trees cleans the car of plates/1280p_car.mp4 with no words, then paints « Trees growing on the road » in two upright strokes: the points of a stroke can hold several paths, drawn in turn before Generate, for one edit. Its « stage_frames », in the plate's own frame numbers, draw stages.png: those frames of the plate, of the Clean matte (the hole the clean plate pass fills) and of each full-size stage, the clean plate pass, the shot, the paint matte and the composite. It is outside quick and all. car_trees_shadow is car_trees with the Clean painted as is over the car and its cast shadow (« whole » off): the same Paint, the same seed. It is outside quick and all. The MP4 plates of plates/ are on the Hugging Face dataset AInVFX/ainvfx-paintaplate (CC BY 4.0): get_plates.py downloads every one into input/plates of the ComfyUI the pack is in. plates/horse_hdr comes from tests/hdr_plate.py, plates/tos_05_4a from tests/tos_plate.py. tos_arm_clean cleans the rig strapped on that forearm, named part by part for SAM 3.1, then paints a robotic arm on the same points with a narrower brush and shorter words. It is outside quick and all, and its stage_frames draw stages.png. A case's « address » adds options to the page's address, and « beside » names a case whose export, run into the same folder, sits beside its own on the sheet. It is outside quick and all. horse_erase's stage_frames draw stages.png at frames 101, 111 and 121. horse_cow_4k and horse_erase_4k are horse_cow and horse_erase with Finish > Upscale on (« upscale »): Export then writes the upscaled set too, and the zip holds it under upscaled/ (the result, the plate, the layer and the matte at 3840 x 2160). They are outside quick and all.

Turn the raised forearm and hand into a robotic arm, in place of the arm and of everything strapped on it. The hand and the forearm become dark brushed-metal segments with visible joints and small actuators at the wrist. The grey tape straps become bundles of thin coloured wires and black cables that run along the forearm; the loose strap ends that hang below the arm become hanging cables. The black plate becomes a machined metal rail bolted on the forearm. The four black rods stay where they are and become thin metal antennas; each orange tip becomes a small, very bright white LED. The red ball at the wrist becomes a red signal lamp. A row of very bright blue-white LEDs shines along the wiring of the forearm and lights the metal around it. The robotic arm keeps the exact position, size, angle and outline of the original arm. Keep the blurred head on the left, the blue sleeve, the blurred street behind, the soft daylight, the depth of field, the framing and the composition exactly as they are.
